paragraphs.text: Elephant is a creature type describing a species of large mammals of the pachyderm family. The species includes modern elephants along with some of their ancient relatives such as mammoths and mastodons .
Sentient, anthropomorphic elephant folk known as loxodons can be found on several planes. They are heavily known for their strong ties to nature and community.

Elephants appear the most often in white and green . Although, Rotting Mastodon and Elephant-rat are black -aligned; Oliphant and Rampaging War Mammoth are red -aligned, and Bastion Mastodon is a colorless artifact creature. In general, loxodons may tend more towards white, while wild elephants tend more towards green.
The first creature to be printed with the creature type was War Elephant in Arabian Nights . The second card printed with the Elephant subtype wasn’t until 1996 (three years in) in Mirage .

The Magic name for humanoid elephants, "Loxodon", was inspired by " Loxodonta ", the genus for African elephants. Although, "Loxodon" is the genus for sliteye sharks . The first Loxodons appeared in Mirrodin .

Mammoth used to be its own creature type before it was obsoleted in the Grand Creature Type Update . As a result, Elephant Graveyard changed to regenerate only elephants because mammoths no longer existed as a creature type. Mammoths regularly see new cards in name, though not in type.
The type reappeared on Domesticated Mammoth , a playtest card in the Mystery Booster set.
Mosstodon s are plant-hybrid mastodons from Naya .
Arcavian loxodons used to live in the city of Zantafar before becoming nomads .
Occasionally, loxodons go to Strixhaven , the most elite school of mages in the multiverse. Some of them are part of the Lorehold college.
Avishkari loxodons are present in the wild forest of Peema .
While there's no evidence of elephants on Bloomburrow , stories about them spark debates about the creatures among animalfolk communities.
Vintaran elephants have four long horns on the side of their head, no trunk, and small tusks. They are used by the rhystic mages of north-eastern Jamuraa .
Not much is known about Eldrainian mammoths. The only known mammoth, Thorn Mammoth , appears to act as wilderness guardian.
Kaldheimr mammoths are bred and harnessed for war ( Battle Mammoth ), but sometimes get out of hand and crush settlements ( Mammoth Growth )
Rabian elephants are trained and guided by humans for combat. They mainly charge the enemy, trampling them and breaking their ranks. A division of war elephants is known as elephantry.

Armodons are elephants native to Rath . They are distinct from other elephants since they have two sets of tusks, two large horns on top of their head, and three or more horns on the base of their trunk. They are almost extinct.
Most of the Ravnican loxodons seek membership in the Selesnya Conclave , it being the most naturalistic of the Ravnican guilds . .
Loxodon are tireless, patient artisans with a gift for stonework. It primarily falls to them to build the guild's magnificent, cathedral-like arboretum structures.
Some other loxodon may also be found in the ranks of the Orzhov Syndicate .
Loxodons were brought to Mirrodin via Memnarch 's soul traps. In Mirrodin, they had as much metal on their bodies as any other beings and had a more clerical rather than a natural focus.

Inhabiting the Razor Fields , these loxodons believed in the Modest Truth , a code of absolute morality that was taken at face value and passed on from generation to generation. In arguments, loxodons proved stubborn and nearly impossible to sway. Some Mirrans even doubted if a loxodon was able to think in shades of grey. loxodons wandered around the fields, dispensing justice in the form of physical punishment and offering atonement. These loxodon ascribed religious superiority to those born albino, believing them to be spiritually pure. Long ago, the Auriok attempted peace with the loxodons, and the leonin attempted war; neither succeeded.

As Mirrodin became New Phyrexia , the Machine Orthodoxy's invasion of the Razor Fields isolated the remaining loxodon. The last remaining living loxodons on the plane are the ones who accompany Ghalma the Shaper, who has settled in Bladehold.

Wild mastodons used to live on Tarkir, as shown by Frontier Mastodon and Sandsteppe Mastodon in Fate Reforged . However, they appear to have gone extinct sometime in the past. Even so, modern elephants have survived to the present. The Abzan Houses and, to a lesser extent, the Mardu Horde have domesticated elephants to serve as transport and war beasts.

Tarkiri loxodons, unlike the loxodons of other planes, more strongly resemble mammoths and are more prominently aligned with green mana. The loxodon are mainly found within Temur Frontier and Abzan Houses .
Elephants are notably present during the phasing of Zhalfir .
Zendikar is home to Terastodon s , a species related to elephants. They are colossal and rhino -like, with nose horns, six tusks, plates of armor, and thick round feet.
Mammoths can also be found in Kazandu .
